scope: Canonical Truss date compiler extension: ten Rust files, four new 0.2.7 schemas, exact ABI 1.1 fixture, and CONTRACT-004 extension; no Truss runtime, SDK defaults, package version or release pin changes.
plan_adjustment: Approved explicit request-version selection through existing Compiler methods: only the 0.2.7 envelope enables Catalog.exact_dates. Old request versions remain date-disabled, old registered backends cannot emit IR 0.2.7, and backend 0.4.41 is explicitly selected. A separate duplicate factory method is not required to preserve old-version behavior.
source_findings: The four 0.2.6 schemas are unchanged. New request/response/backend/IR schemas consistently use 0.2.7 and add Date only in exact scalar/parameter domains; referenced repository schemas exist.

Backend 0.4.41 derives its existing query behavior from 0.4.39, not the native-70-specific 0.4.40. The new backend alone registers Date capabilities and exact query ABI 1.1 with fixture SHA-256 9b67333abf263078e7e7239fe5accc228b063dc2fcc5488ca068d7331986949f.

Date field admission is gated by the explicit request version and UMF 0.8 descriptor. Exact family matching and original typed token/provenance checks are retained. Canonical validation requires exactly ten ASCII characters and delegates Gregorian validity to the existing private zero-clock instant validator, discarding its computed key and preserving the original date text.

Date equality emits C-collated text comparisons. No PostgreSQL date/timestamp cast or session-timezone dependency is introduced. Existing absence/null/value projection and SQL UNKNOWN behavior remain; no date ordering, arithmetic, range, key or page-key capability is added.

The bounded push_date helper follows the existing slot-emission pattern; resolver and common backend emission independently validate canonical Date tokens. Final Build.canonical_dates field and initializer propagation are present.

CONTRACT-004 accurately defines an explicit canonical Truss date subset rather than claiming all UMF date/refinement semantics, preserves old contracts, and requires host slot/source/authority checks. Callable ABI signatures are unchanged; descriptor and supported cell domain are explicitly versioned.
